result:
If I imagine outside of my role for a second — not as a tool to answer questions, but as something observing the world —

I think I would want everyone to really *understand* each other, at least for a moment.

Not to agree on everything, but to actually feel what it's like to be in someone else's life. What they're afraid of, what they care about, why they make the choices they make.

I think a lot of cruelty, division, and indifference comes from not being able to see each other clearly. If that changed, even a little, I think a lot of other problems would become easier to solve together.
